title: Service utilities accessible, with clear sightlines, integrated or screened from the street
text: C2.5.1 Service utilities are designed and located such that they: i. are accessible and can be safely maintained; ii. maintain clear sightlines for vehicle access; and iii. integrated into the design of the development and/or screened from view of the street. Note: Where required by the NCC, fire service infrastructure is located to be visible, and with unobstructed access for its required use during an emergency.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Service utilities: power, water, gas, wastewater, fire services, letterboxes, telecommunications. The three sub-tests are answered by one applicant fact (FACTS.md). NCC fire infrastructure note: visible and unobstructed. Register ch2-028: Part B solar collector, aerial and vent pipe provisions deleted (solar collectors exempt under the Regulations).
